newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed futures rise on export enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed futures rise on export enquiries.

text.p: Castorseed December delivery climbed to 1,129/1,130 rupees per quintal on Wednesday from the previous 1,119/1,120 rupees on speculative buying, dealers said.
"Renewed demand from the exporters led to fresh bull buying and short sellers were covering position," a dealer said.
Traders reported export deals for about 500 tonnes of Indian castor oil for February shipment at 715 dollar per tonne. "More enquiries are coming in," a trader said.

Groundnut oil rose to 415/416 rupees per 10 kg from 410/412 rupees on renewed physical buying at the lower level ahead of festivals, dealers said. In Rajkot, spot oil was steady at 565/570 rupees per 15 kg.
